title: Low-degree Fourier weight of a threshold function
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Suppose there are real coefficients $a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n$ such that $f(x)$ equals $1$ when $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i\geq 0$ and equals $-1$ otherwise. Then the sum of the squares of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $1$ is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is represented by the stated affine threshold, with value $1$ at zero
